items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: me, George, Wesley Prince and my brother on piano, we played in a joint out in Long Beach

ctx.x: When you got to L.A. then you started playing on rhythm & blues and — was it rock & roll yet? Was it called rock & roll?

Well I didn’t start playing rhythm & blues, I started playing anywhere I could get a job, but actually one of my first jobs really was a jazz job, kind of a jazz job in the city of Long Beach, with a drummer called George Jenkins, who was Dinah Washington’s first husband, and played with Lionel Hampton and he was a great drummer. Let’s see, me, George, Wesley Prince and my brother on piano, we played in a joint out in Long Beach which was kind of a sailor town with bars and music six nights a week. And stayed…
I guess they call that scuffling, huh?
